martial_discipline.title: Martial Discipline
martial_discipline.description: Establish the Warrior as the adaptable martial baseline with broad technique mastery.

second_wind.title: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Gain limited combat recovery rather than passive regeneration.

aegis_stance.title: Aegis Stance
aegis_stance.description: Adopt a defensive stance that trades some tempo for stronger guarding and stability.

tactical_tempo.title: Tactical Tempo
tactical_tempo.description: Reward deliberate attacks, guards and technique transitions with short-lived martial momentum.

heroic_action.title: Heroic Action
heroic_action.description: Unlock a major burst of martial initiative and technique tempo.
